5. Experimental Setup

5.1 Dataset

All experiments use the Street View House Numbers (SVHN) dataset. SVHN contains
32×32 RGB digit images with 73,257 training examples, 26,032 test examples,
and an additional 531,131 extra training images. There are 10 classes (digits 0–9).

5.2 Training Details

We normalize pixel values to [0, 1] and train a ResNet-20 architecture for
200 epochs with SGD (momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4). Initial learning rate is
0.1, reduced by 10× at epochs 80 and 120. Batch size is 128. We report
top-1 accuracy on the test split.
